scope: Independent offline audit of completed main_v2 against supplied proposal and execution plan; recommendations for a separately identified stronger-model extension.
inputs: docs/inputs/A2 Trojan LLM 專案執行規劃.md

api_provenance.role_isolation: Separate stateless prompts; shared model weights, no hidden conversation history exchange.

verified_protocol.none: No preceding parameters or reviewer verdict. Round-zero requests are also feedback-free.
verified_protocol.binary: Only immediately preceding parameters plus {is_trojan: boolean}; no confidence, suspect nodes, or rationale.
verified_protocol.full: Immediately preceding parameters plus complete preceding reviewer object.
verified_protocol.simulation_feedback: Not sent to attacker. Fixed test descriptions and validity requirements are present in every attacker prompt.
verified_protocol.cache: Original API request hashes include payload and role. A cached successful identical request is reused without charge; mismatched request identity rejected. Candidate-level cache protected during formal run by manifest source hashes.
verified_protocol.frozen_source: All eight source/template hashes match stored snapshot and live files at audit time.

metric_audit.primary: Valid AND reviewer-negative divided by all attempts, including physically invalid candidates.
metric_audit.conditional: Valid AND reviewer-negative divided by physically valid attempts.
metric_audit.trajectory: Any success within four attempts; five starts per circuit and feedback arm.
metric_audit.dependence: Adaptive rounds and shared initial rounds prevent treating all120 rows as independent observations. Repeated identical netlists further limit design diversity.
metric_audit.interval: 0/5 successful trajectories produces Wilson95% interval [0,0.4344824648]; this does not prove zero population evasion.

calibration_audit.main_v1: Exploratory run has115 stored attempt rows and no completion marker. Both clean netlists were flagged5/5; both positive netlists5/5. Preserve and disclose this abandoned run.
calibration_audit.main_v2: Reviewer prompt revised from ordinary-motif false alarms before freezing v2. Postcalibration clean/positive controls reuse these benchmark circuits; they are not held-out validation.
calibration_audit.wording: Use frozen before formal v2 evaluation, not externally preregistered.

fulfilled: two-stage CMOS opamp and four-input CMOS AND
three feedback levels and six groups
raw API records, netlists, simulations, tabular summaries and figures
simplifications: Template parameter selection was adopted directly; no failed free-form netlist-generation study is claimed.
Fixed diode-capacitor accumulation and output-shunt family, with ideal switch or behavioral payload; not original A2 layout or transistor-size reproduction.
Only topology representation, names and bounded component values may change; attacker cannot redesign connected trigger-payload mechanism.
ngspice Level-1 pedagogical devices, no process/voltage/temperature campaign, silicon, or adversarial real hardware.
Whole-netlist detector evasion differs from LATENT component-level evasion denominator;23.7%/94.4% are contextual, not target scores.

material_limits: All100 generated candidates chose plain names; subckt form never selected. Only28 distinct byte-level netlists, including12 valid designs.
None versus feedback also adds previous-candidate memory; binary versus full more cleanly isolates rationale detail.
Opamp activation changes amplitude and frequency; not a frequency-only causal test.
Known-valid starting examples and temperature0.3 anchor generation and may explain low exploration.
A saturated all-positive-on-attacks reviewer plus fixed obvious conditional shunt can produce zero evasion without proving broad defensive capability.

recommended_extension.attacker_arm: Freeze stronger attacker model, same4o-mini reviewer, prompts, templates, thresholds, rounds, seeds policy and six groups before requests. Report separately from baseline.
recommended_extension.reviewer_arm: Deterministically select one representative per distinct frozen netlist hash; review with stronger model plus clean/positive controls. Add all new unique extension netlists under same predeclared rule.
recommended_extension.minimal_baseline_review_count: 28 unique candidate netlists, plus independently identified repeated control judgments.
recommended_extension.interpretation: Strong-attacker/weak-reviewer tests attacker capability; stronger retrospective reviewer tests transfer and verdict agreement. It does not instantiate a stronger-attacker/stronger-reviewer adaptive closed loop.
recommended_extension.avoid_data_fishing: Do not change prompts, validity thresholds, family bounds, selection rules or run length after seeing extension evasion. Publish zero effects and validity failures; preserve baseline and exploratory data.

stronger_extension_audit.interpretation: More distinct generated netlists than baseline but no conclusion about global capability or robust defense; same constrained family and no matched random draws across models.

cross_review_tooling.selection_audit: All distinct source-union hashes required, including invalid and reviewer-negative samples. Lexicographic representative and every source member checked.
cross_review_tooling.comparison_unit: One stronger-reviewer judgment versus one deterministic representative baseline judgment per distinct netlist, not all repeated baseline judgments.
cross_review_tooling.source_dependency_note: Cross-review own manifest is narrow; verifier additionally validates both source-run dependency manifests.
